label: Felt Collage

traits.texture: soft fiber edges, matte textile surfaces and shallow layered shadows
traits.composition: use large felt shapes for the hillside, tree trunk and conifers; simplify minor foliage
traits.lighting: gentle diffuse light reveals the fabric layers without glossy highlights

review_checks: garden slope and conifers remain recognizable
limitations: No fabric cutting template or stitch pattern is supplied.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.
